findings.title: No native OpenCode 2.2.5 adapter or worker launcher exists; the supervisor-to-Gemma interface is protocol-only with a synthetic transport
Missing-controller-ledger fails open: absent ledger is silently created and treated as 'not stopped'
120-minute whole-workflow deadline is caller-supplied, not derived from the registration
Budget-term matching over a full non-stream response body can latch the global admission stop on model/task text
Candidate-added Gemma/Terra usage mappings conflict with the supplied frozen usage-record schema; subset partition is unvalidated
Broker and relay Unix sockets are not permission-restricted
Construction-input provenance diverges from the supplied current inputs
Non-'final' terminal reasons do not validate actor/session identity
prompt_sha256/config_sha256 are recorded but never verified against actual artifacts
Any relay exception sets the shared cancel event, conflating supervisor-side client aborts with infrastructure failure
Hardcoded five-arm list and optional registration binding in Store

scope: Source/synthetic review of preserved partial prototype; actual native/root runtime remains unimplemented/unqualified in that candidate.
